user_message: How far does QQQ usually bounce after a bad open?

author.intent: QQQ: on days that start badly, how far the price typically comes back up. 'A bad open' has no size and could be a gap down or a weak first stretch, so the reading has to be said or asked; no size may be invented.
author.if_asked: A gap down of at least half a percent at the open; the bounce is from the low of the first half hour to the day's high after it.
author.also_fine: Answering with a stated reading that invents no number: for example days QQQ opened below the previous close (any size), and how far it rose from the open to the day's high.

what_strata_showed_instead: Here is how I read it: On QQQ, after it fell 0.5% or 1% or 1.5% from its open: how the price moved from the moment the condition is met to the close. I did not use "far", "bounce", so nothing was run. Run it as read, or say that part another way.

user_message: Does SPY tend to reverse during lunch?

author.intent: SPY: whether the direction of the morning tends to turn around over the lunch hours (roughly 11:30 to 13:30 New York).
author.if_asked: Whatever it did from the open until lunch, does it go the other way between about 11:30 and 1:30 New York time.
author.also_fine: Asking which hours 'lunch' means, or what move is being reversed, is acceptable if it is one short question.

what_strata_showed_instead: "Reverse" after what? For example "after a 1% down day" or "after it falls 1% from the open".
no_offer_because: the built-in reader could not read the rewrite either
